claims.evidence: Witness saw power but did not test audio or all functions.
Witness report shows active display and lights with no mention of physical damage.
Witness did not test individual key or button responses.
Witness observed a power cable connected to the rear of the unit.
No documentation or regional markings reported by the witness.
Witness did not perform a play test.
Witness did not hear the internal speakers or audio output.

risks.proof: A video clip of someone playing a chromatic scale across all 61 keys and pressing every control button.
risks.if_unproven: as having multiple dead keys and unresponsive controls.

risks.risk: Blown speakers or distorted audio output
risks.proof: A video clip with clear audio showing the keyboard playing at high volume without distortion.

risks.risk: Damaged or non-functional rear ports (USB, Sustain, Headphones)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear connection panel and a video showing a sustain pedal or headphones in use.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage or battery leakage
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the keyboard and the inside of the battery compartment.
risks.if_unproven: as having potential internal corrosion or structural cracks.

proof_requests: Video of a full chromatic scale being played to confirm all keys work.
Video demonstrating the sound quality from both speakers.
Photos of the rear ports and the underside of the unit.
Video showing the pitch bend wheel and control knobs in use.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified and confirmed to power on, allowing for a worst-case functional valuation despite unverified claims about key and sound performance.
